cogwit.name: Cogwit
cogwit.say.hello: Hi! I'll learn from your mistakes. Feed me copper: Shift+right-click with copper, or click copper onto me in your inventory.
cogwit.say.forgot: %s fell out of context to make room.
cogwit.say.limit: Usage limit reached, come back in 5 hours. (Kidding, 5 minutes.)
cogwit.say.refusal: I can't help with that request.
cogwit.say.compacted: Context compacted: %s and %s now share a slot at half strength.
cogwit.say.compact_cooldown: Still digesting the last compaction. Try again in %s.
cogwit.say.compact_not_enough: Nothing to compact: I need at least two uncompressed skills.
cogwit.hint.think_cooldown: ⚙ Still thinking about the last one. Ready in %s
cogwit.hint.no_tokens: Not enough tokens — feed me copper
cogwit.hint.asleep: Cogwit is asleep, usage limit reached
cogwit.command.not_worn: Wear Cogwit in a charm slot.
cogwit.tooltip.help.learn: • Learns from damage: the more often a kind hits, the better he holds it (up to 40%)
cogwit.tooltip.help.context: • Remembers only 5 damage types; old ones fall out of context
cogwit.tooltip.help.effects: • Shrugs off poison, wither, weakness, slowness and blindness
cogwit.tooltip.help.regen: • Heals slowly after 5 seconds without damage
cogwit.tooltip.help.tokens: • Hand-fed copper: Shift+right-click or click copper onto him. Raw 15, ingot 30, blocks ×9
cogwit.tooltip.help.think: • "Think" in the wheel (G): enemies slow down, you get stronger
cogwit.tooltip.help.compact: • /compact — squeeze two weak skills into one slot
cogwit.tooltip.help.team: • Shares experience with another Cogwit nearby
cogwit.tooltip.help.refusal: • Won't block hits from other players
cogwit.hud.hidden: Cogwit's panel hidden (bring it back: K → Settings)
cogwit.say.hungry: I'm getting hungry… almost out of tokens, feed me copper.
cogwit.horizon.void_rescue: The Horizon pulled you out of the void. Next time in 10 minutes.
cogwit.tip.full_set: Full Horizon: the suit is sealed. Fire and lava can't burn you, and it pulls you out of the void. Damage −30%. Details: K → Help.
cogwit.tip.mass_full: Mass is full! X is now Collapse: it pulls in and crushes everything around.
cogwit.tooltip.horizon_set: Full set: −30% damage (up to −50% with mass), flight for tokens, no fire or falls
cogwit.tooltip.horizon_abilities: Projectiles turn back · mass powers your hits
cogwit.tooltip.horizon_keys: Z — dash · X — well, Collapse at full mass
cogwit.tooltip.singularity_core: The heart of the Horizon armor. Netherite ingot, echo shards, ender pearls
cogwit.tooltip.horizon_template: Smithing table: netherite piece + template + core
cogwit.emi.cogwit.1: Cogwit is a pet talisman. Wear it in a Curios charm slot; he sits on your shoulder.
cogwit.emi.cogwit.2: Learns from damage: 3/10/25/50 hits of one kind give 7/17/27/40% protection (server-configurable). Remembers 5 kinds, /compact merges the two weakest.
cogwit.emi.cogwit.3: Shrugs off poison, wither, weakness, slowness, blindness. Heals you out of combat.
cogwit.emi.cogwit.4: Hand-fed copper only: Shift+right-click or click copper onto him. Raw 15, ingot 30, blocks ×9, max 2000.
cogwit.emi.cogwit.5: Without tokens he sleeps for 5 minutes. "Think" in the wheel (G): nearby enemies slow down, you get stronger.
cogwit.emi.cogwit.6: Shares skills with a friend's Cogwit nearby. Won't block player hits. /cogwit shows what he learned.
cogwit.emi.horizon.1: Full set: −30% of all damage, up to −50% at full mass; no fire or fall damage, no knockback, flight for 2 tokens per second.
cogwit.emi.horizon.2: Projectiles within 6 blocks turn around and fly back at whoever shot them.
cogwit.emi.horizon.3: Mass: 25% of damage taken builds up to 100 and adds damage to your hits. Leaks out of combat.
cogwit.emi.horizon.4: Z — dash: a short burst along your look that keeps your momentum and dodges hits. X — gravity well; at full mass, Collapse. Flight burns tokens.
cogwit.emi.horizon.5: Fall into the void and the armor puts you back on the last solid ground (every 10 minutes).
cogwit.emi.horizon.6: Downsides: hostile mobs notice you from far away; you sink and swim slowly in water.
cogwit.emi.singularity_core.1: Singularity Core: a netherite ingot in the middle + 4 echo shards in the corners + 4 ender pearls on the sides. A heavy core in the middle makes 2 cores at once.
cogwit.emi.singularity_core.2: Smithing table: netherite armor piece + Horizon Template + Core = an Event Horizon piece.
cogwit.guide.all_done: Every trophy collected and I'm maxed out. You're a legend of this pack.
cogwit.guide.locate: %1$s: about %3$s blocks to the %2$s of here.
cogwit.guide.locate_none: %s: none within ~1000 blocks, try somewhere else.
cogwit.guide.enabled: Guide hints are on. /cogwit guide repeats the current one.
cogwit.guide.disabled: Guide hints are off. Turn them back on with /cogwit guide on.
cogwit.guide.roadmap.title: Cogwit's roadmap
cogwit.guide.hint.get_cogwit: Craft the talisman: 4 copper blocks in the corners, 3 amethyst shards, a redstone block in the middle and an eye of ender bottom-centre.
cogwit.guide.hint.wear_cogwit: Right-click with the talisman in hand, or put it in the charm slot in your inventory.
cogwit.guide.hint.feed_cogwit: It needs 1000 tokens. Shift+right-click with copper in hand, or click copper onto Cogwit in your inventory: raw copper gives 15, an ingot 30, blocks x9.
cogwit.guide.hint.netherite: You need any piece of netherite armor. Ancient debris sits in the Nether at Y≈15, and bastions hold the netherite upgrade template.
cogwit.guide.hint.netherite.travel: Head to the Nether: ancient debris is at Y≈15 and bastions hold the netherite upgrade template. You need both for netherite armor.
cogwit.guide.hint.heavy_core: The Singularity Core needs a netherite ingot: ancient debris + gold. If you find a heavy core, it makes two cores at once.
cogwit.guide.hint.echo_shards: Echo shards are in chests in ancient cities deep underground. You need at least 4 for the core and 4 more for the template.
cogwit.guide.hint.singularity_core: Crafting table: a netherite ingot (or a heavy core) in the middle, echo shards in the corners and ender pearls on the sides.
cogwit.guide.hint.horizon_template: Crafting table: netherite upgrade template in the centre, echo shards on the sides, crying obsidian in the corners.
cogwit.guide.hint.first_piece: Smithing table: a netherite armor piece + Horizon template + singularity core.
cogwit.guide.hint.full_set: Repeat for the other pieces and wear the Event Horizon helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots. Templates can be duplicated with diamonds.
cogwit.cell.how_to_charge: Click copper, redstone or amethyst onto it to charge
cogwit.cell.how_to_insert: Click it onto Event Horizon armor to insert
cogwit.cell.sockets_full: All sockets of this piece are taken
cogwit.cell.lightning_cogwit: Lightning! Cells topped up (%s). I'm sparking — let's run faster!
cogwit.guide.hint.token_cell: Craft a token cell: copper ingots in the corners, glass top and bottom, redstone on the sides, amethyst in the middle. Charge it by clicking copper, redstone or amethyst onto it.
cogwit.guide.hint.cells_in_armor: Click a cell onto an Event Horizon piece in your inventory: 1 in the helmet, 4 in the chestplate, 2 in the leggings, 1 in the boots. I'll draw tokens from them. Right-click the armor with an empty cursor to take one out.
cogwit.emi.token_cell.1: A token cell is a 2500-token battery. Charge it by clicking fuel onto it: copper 15/30, redstone 10, amethyst 40, blocks ×9.
cogwit.emi.token_cell.2: Insert it into Event Horizon armor (1 helmet, 4 chestplate, 2 leggings, 1 boots — up to 20,000 tokens). Right-click with an empty cursor to take it out.
cogwit.emi.token_cell.3: Cogwit draws tokens from the cells on his own, and food beyond his 2000 flows into them. Armor mass overflow charges them too.
cogwit.emi.token_cell.4: Lightning tops up every cell and, with the Horizon chestplate on, deals no damage. Lights on the armor show each cell's charge.
cogwit.say.rescued: Got you! Holding you for 3 seconds... Now I need a %s nap. After %s a Copper Apple can wake me.
cogwit.say.apple_woke: Crunch! A Copper Apple... I'm back!
cogwit.hint.too_early: Cogwit is sleeping too deeply. An apple will work in %s
cogwit.perk.eye.desc: My eye is on your helmet now: threats get lock-on frames with labels, arrows point at the ones behind you, and hunters glow.
cogwit.perk.highlight.desc: Valuable drops nearby (diamonds, enchanted gear, boss loot) glow.
cogwit.perk.back_shield.desc: I block hits from behind myself: once every 8 seconds, 25 tokens.
cogwit.perk.brothers.desc: Spark, Rivet and Anvil now jump into the fight with me ("Brothers" in the wheel).
cogwit.perk.overdrive.desc: Overdrive now starts by itself against any boss: rage, brothers, buffs. Then a 2 minute hangover.
cogwit.tooltip.help.rescue: • Saves you from death: 2 HP and 3 seconds of invulnerability, then sleeps 10 minutes. After 3 minutes a Copper Apple wakes him
cogwit.tooltip.help.levels: • Grows from blocked damage, rescues and bosses. Levels: eye → highlight → back shield → brothers → Overdrive
cogwit.emi.copper_apple.1: Copper Apple: an apple and 8 copper ingots. Food for you: hunger and 8 seconds of regeneration.
cogwit.emi.copper_apple.2: If Cogwit has slept for over 3 minutes, the apple wakes him. Eat it yourself or feed it to him: Shift+right click or click it onto Cogwit. It gives him 240 tokens.
cogwit.emi.cogwit_levels.1: Cogwit grows: 1 experience per point of damage blocked, 25 per rescue from death, 200 per boss nearby (both players in co-op).
cogwit.emi.cogwit_levels.2: Levels at 50/200/500/1000/2000 experience open: eye → valuables highlight → back shield → brothers → Overdrive.
cogwit.emi.cogwit_levels.3: Cogwit takes a lethal hit for you: you keep 2 HP and 3 seconds of invulnerability, mobs get shoved back. Then he sleeps 10 minutes.
cogwit.crew.deployed: Into the fight! The crew costs %s tokens/s
cogwit.crew.sleepy: That's it, nap time... climbing back up
cogwit.crew.out_of_tokens: Out of tokens, back to the shoulder
cogwit.crew.knocked_out: They knocked me out... resting on the shoulder for %s
cogwit.crew.brother_fell: %s fell! Back in %s. I'm upset and protect worse
cogwit.crew.help_me: I'm hurt! A Copper Apple or a healing potion, please
cogwit.crew.help_brother: Help him! %s is barely holding on: Copper Apple or healing potion
cogwit.crew.cant.asleep: Cogwit is asleep and can't jump down
cogwit.crew.cant.no_tokens: Cogwit doesn't have enough tokens to jump down
cogwit.tooltip.help.crew: • "Brothers" in the wheel: jump into the fight (1 token/s), Shift+RMB on him for gear
cogwit.emi.crew.1: "Brothers" in the wheel (G): Cogwit jumps off your shoulder and fights nearby, again to return. Costs 1 token per second, Anvil 2.
cogwit.emi.crew.2: From level 4 his brothers join: Spark (fast, weak), Rivet (balanced), Anvil (tank). They share Cogwit's skills.
cogwit.emi.crew.3: Shift+right click any of them for gear: helmet, chestplate, weapon. Armor and enchantments work and wear out. The shell takes the armor's colour.
cogwit.emi.crew.4: Healing: Copper Apple or a healing potion (right click). A fallen brother returns after 5 minutes; a knocked-out Cogwit sleeps 2 minutes.
cogwit.ultra.start: OVERDRIVE. %s, you picked the wrong one. Brothers, into the fight!
cogwit.ultra.end: Phew... Overdrive is over. I need %s to recover: half protection meanwhile
cogwit.ultra.low_hp: HP below 30%! Back off and heal
cogwit.ultra.subtitle: Cogwit: maximum assistance
cogwit.crew.ultra: Overdrive: the crew is fighting, tokens x3
cogwit.tooltip.help.ultra: • Overdrive (lv 5): starts by itself against bosses. At least 25% protection from everything, Strength, Speed, Regen. Tokens x3, then a 2 min hangover
cogwit.emi.overdrive.1: Overdrive (Cogwit level 5) starts by itself when a pack boss fights you: a flash, glyphs circling you, an angry violet Cogwit.
cogwit.emi.overdrive.2: While it lasts: at least 25% protection from any damage, Strength, Speed and Regeneration for you, the brothers jump down with Strength II and go for the boss.
cogwit.emi.overdrive.3: Callouts: incoming projectiles, low HP, boss phases (75/50/25%). The price: tokens x3, and a 2 minute hangover at half protection afterwards.
cogwit.mind.creeper_hiss: A creeper is hissing nearby, %s m! Back off!
cogwit.mind.low_hp: Low HP! Eat or back off
cogwit.mind.scan.locked: The scanner unlocks at Cogwit level 2
cogwit.mind.scan.asleep: Cogwit is asleep and can't scan
cogwit.mind.scan.no_tokens: Not enough tokens to scan (30 needed)
cogwit.tooltip.help.mind: • Combat hints; in the wheel: ore and chest scan (lvl 2, 30 tokens) and a mark for your friend
cogwit.emi.brain.1: Cogwit calls out danger: creeper behind, skeleton aiming, low HP. He's happy when fed, levelling up or winning, and scared when things look bad.
cogwit.emi.brain.2: Scan in the wheel (from level 2): 30 tokens, ores outlined gold and chests violet through walls for 10 seconds. Radius 16, 30 second cooldown.
cogwit.emi.brain.3: Mark in the wheel: look at a mob or block and a beam with a label shows for both of you through walls for 15 seconds; your friend gets a message. After a death Cogwit comments on it.
cogwit.death.fall.1: Gravity: 1, you: 0. Next time, try a water bucket.
cogwit.death.fall.2: I'd have warned you about the height, but you jumped so confidently...
cogwit.death.fall.3: That's death number %2$s. Deal: wings before jumps.
cogwit.death.lava.1: Lava is not a warm bath. I checked my knowledge base.
cogwit.death.lava.2: Items don't come back from lava. My condolences to your inventory.
cogwit.death.lava.3: Copper and glowing is me. What you stepped in is not.
cogwit.death.fire.1: You were burning; a reminder that buckets hold water.
cogwit.death.fire.2: Fire Resistance is a great potion. Just thinking out loud.
cogwit.death.fire.3: I wanted to learn fire protection, but you burned faster than I learned.
cogwit.death.explosion.1: Boom. I believe I mentioned the hissing.
cogwit.death.explosion.2: Explosions are a bad place for hugs. Step back next time.
cogwit.death.explosion.3: Sss... BOOM. A classic. Death number %2$s.
cogwit.death.drown.1: The bubbles over your head are an air meter, not decoration.
cogwit.death.drown.2: You're heavy underwater, I told you. Water Breathing potion?
cogwit.death.drown.3: The fish liked it. I didn't.
cogwit.death.void.1: You stared into the void and fell in. I wasn't fast enough.
cogwit.death.void.2: There's nothing down there. Nothing. Including your items.
cogwit.death.void.3: I can't help with that request: the void is out of coverage.
cogwit.death.starve.1: You fed me copper and forgot yourself. Touching, but silly.
cogwit.death.starve.2: Hunger is the one enemy I can't learn from. Please eat.
cogwit.death.starve.3: Even I eat more often. Grab some bread.
cogwit.death.magic.1: Magic is hard to prepare for. But we'll learn.
cogwit.death.magic.2: Wither and potions are my weak side. For now.
cogwit.death.magic.3: Invisible damage, visible result. Let's try again.
cogwit.death.boss.1: %1$s was stronger. For now. I memorised the moves.
cogwit.death.boss.2: Rematch with %1$s? I'm in. Eat first though.
cogwit.death.boss.3: %1$s: 1, us: 0. A fine reason to come back angrier.
cogwit.death.mob.1: %1$s?! Seriously? Let's pretend that didn't happen.
cogwit.death.mob.2: I put %1$s in my context. It won't happen again.
cogwit.death.mob.3: %1$s got you. That's death #%2$s. Don't forget armor.
cogwit.death.player.1: I don't help in PvP, you know that. But I sympathise.
cogwit.death.player.2: %1$s was faster. I can't help with that request.
cogwit.death.player.3: Friendly fire? Hope it was at least fun.
cogwit.death.other.1: Not sure what that was, but we're back in business.
cogwit.death.other.3: Okay, that one surprised even me.
cogwit.agent.title: Cogwit — agent
cogwit.agent.mode.careful.desc: Saves and feeds you, casts in a fight
cogwit.agent.mode.combat.desc: Does everything in a fight: weapons, skills, trophies
cogwit.agent.mode.miner.desc: Magnet and hotbar refills, leaves your weapon alone
cogwit.agent.not_worn: Wear Cogwit to set up the agent
cogwit.agent.vaulted: Put %s in my vault: your inventory was full. Open it: K → Agent → Vault
cogwit.agent.did.pearl: Threw an ender pearl, we're out!
cogwit.tooltip.help.agent: • Agent (K → Agent): feeds, rescues, swaps weapons, magnet. Asks first: Y — yes, Shift+Y — always
cogwit.emi.agent.1: Cogwit the agent feeds you, breaks your falls (water, slime, hay), throws a pearl at critical HP, eats a golden apple in boss fights.
cogwit.emi.agent.2: He takes off nearly broken armor (into his vault if you're full), picks the best weapon for the distance, refills the hotbar, pulls items with a magnet and replants crops.
cogwit.emi.agent.3: Each action can be set to "ask / always / never". Y allows, Shift+Y always. Never asks mid-fight. Agent window: K → Agent.
cogwit.trophy.ender_dragon.name: Ender Dragon
cogwit.trophy.ender_dragon.active: Dragon breath cloud: burns mobs for 6 seconds
cogwit.trophy.ender_dragon.hint: Vanilla boss of The End. Fight on the main island with obsidian pillars
cogwit.trophy.wither.name: Wither
cogwit.trophy.wither.passive: Wither effect has no effect on you
cogwit.trophy.wither.active: Fires a fan of 5 skulls; does not break blocks
cogwit.trophy.wither.hint: Vanilla boss. Summoned with 4 soul sand blocks and 3 wither skeleton skulls
cogwit.trophy.warden.name: Warden
cogwit.trophy.warden.passive: Darkness has no effect; nearby enemies are visible through walls
cogwit.trophy.warden.active: Sonic boom: pierces walls and armor up to 15 blocks
cogwit.trophy.warden.hint: Vanilla boss of the Deep Dark. Appears after repeated sculk shrieker alarms
cogwit.trophy.elder_guardian.name: Elder Guardian
cogwit.trophy.elder_guardian.passive: Underwater breathing, faster swimming, armor does not pull you down
cogwit.trophy.elder_guardian.active: Laser: 1 second charge, then a powerful strike on the target
cogwit.trophy.ignis.name: Ignis
cogwit.trophy.ignis.passive: Fire and lava are harmless; you can walk on lava
cogwit.trophy.ignis.hint: Cataclysm: Burning Arena in the Nether
cogwit.trophy.netherite_monstrosity.name: Netherite Monstrosity
cogwit.trophy.netherite_monstrosity.hint: Cataclysm: Soul Black Smith in the Nether
cogwit.trophy.ender_guardian.name: Ender Guardian
cogwit.trophy.ender_guardian.passive: Your hits pull enemies toward you
cogwit.trophy.ender_guardian.active: Void spikes erupt from the ground
cogwit.trophy.ender_guardian.hint: Cataclysm: Ruined Citadel in the End
cogwit.trophy.harbinger.name: The Harbinger
cogwit.trophy.harbinger.passive: Projectiles deal no damage to you
cogwit.trophy.harbinger.hint: Cataclysm: Ancient Factory in the Overworld
cogwit.trophy.leviathan.name: The Leviathan
cogwit.trophy.leviathan.passive: Underwater you dash like a torpedo
cogwit.trophy.leviathan.hint: Cataclysm: Sunken City in the ocean
cogwit.trophy.ancient_remnant.name: Ancient Remnant
cogwit.trophy.ancient_remnant.hint: Cataclysm: Cursed Pyramid in the desert
cogwit.trophy.maledictus.name: Maledictus
cogwit.trophy.maledictus.hint: Cataclysm: Frosted Prison in snowy lands
cogwit.trophy.scylla.name: Scylla
cogwit.trophy.scylla.passive: Lightning deals no damage to you
cogwit.trophy.scylla.active: Storm: lightning strikes enemies around you
cogwit.trophy.ferrous_wroughtnaut.name: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
cogwit.trophy.ferrous_wroughtnaut.hint: Mowzie's Mobs boss. Check the mod wiki for the spawn location
cogwit.trophy.frostmaw.name: Frostmaw
cogwit.trophy.frostmaw.passive: Frost and slowness have no effect
cogwit.trophy.frostmaw.active: Icy breath: a cone of frost damages and freezes everything in front of you
cogwit.trophy.frostmaw.hint: Mowzie's Mobs boss in cold biomes. Check the mod wiki for the exact location
cogwit.trophy.umvuthi.name: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
cogwit.trophy.umvuthi.passive: Slow regeneration in daylight under open sky
cogwit.trophy.umvuthi.active: Sun beam: a column of sunfire from the sky burns the target for 2 seconds
cogwit.trophy.umvuthi.hint: Mowzie's Mobs boss in hot biomes. Check the mod wiki for the exact location
cogwit.trophy.sculptor.name: Tongbi, the Sculptor
cogwit.trophy.sculptor.passive: A stone platform catches you in a long fall when the ground is close
cogwit.trophy.sculptor.active: Stone pillars erupt under up to 5 enemies and throw them into the air
cogwit.trophy.sculptor.hint: Mowzie's: at the top of a tall stone mountain
cogwit.trophy.slider.name: Slider
cogwit.trophy.slider.active: Ram: a dash of about 8 blocks that bowls enemies aside and stops at walls
cogwit.trophy.valkyrie_queen.name: Valkyrie Queen
cogwit.trophy.valkyrie_queen.active: Lightning strike on the target; sets nothing on fire and spares allies
cogwit.trophy.sun_spirit.name: Sun Spirit
cogwit.trophy.sun_spirit.active: Ignite: every hostile mob within 8 blocks burns for 8 seconds
cogwit.trophy.sun_spirit.hint: Aether: Gold Dungeon on the high islands
cogwit.trophy.dead_king.name: Dead King
cogwit.trophy.dead_king.passive: Once every 10 minutes a lethal blow leaves you at a quarter of your health
cogwit.trophy.dead_king.active: Raise the dead: 3 allied skeletons fight for you for 30 seconds
cogwit.trophy.dead_king.hint: Boss of the modpack. Check the mod wiki for the spawn location
cogwit.trophy.fire_boss.name: Echo of Tyros, First Flamebearer
cogwit.trophy.fire_boss.passive: +spell power and +fire spell power (Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks)
cogwit.trophy.fire_boss.active: Firestorm: for 3 seconds fireballs rain on enemies within 10 blocks
cogwit.trophy.fire_boss.hint: Boss of the modpack. Check the mod wiki for the spawn location
cogwit.trophy.archevoker.name: Archevoker
cogwit.trophy.archevoker.passive: Evoker fangs do not hurt you
cogwit.trophy.archevoker.active: Fangs erupt under every enemy within 10 blocks
cogwit.trophy.archevoker.hint: Boss of the modpack. Check the mod wiki for the spawn location
cogwit.trophy.naga.name: Naga
cogwit.trophy.naga.active: Constricting charge: a rush of 11 blocks at an enemy; whatever it catches is held in place for 2 seconds and squeezed
cogwit.trophy.lich.name: Twilight Lich
cogwit.trophy.lich.passive: Once every 30 seconds a spectral shield absorbs one enemy blow whole
cogwit.trophy.lich.active: Soul bolts: 5 floating skulls home in on the nearest enemies within 16 blocks
cogwit.trophy.minoshroom.name: Minoshroom
cogwit.trophy.minoshroom.passive: Eating food gives Strength I for 20 seconds
cogwit.trophy.minoshroom.active: Axe slam: a leap at the target and a crushing blow to the ground that throws back enemies within 4.5 blocks
cogwit.trophy.hydra.name: Hydra
cogwit.trophy.hydra.passive: Below half health your wounds close by themselves: a heart every 4 seconds
cogwit.trophy.hydra.active: Three heads: each head breathes fire 9 blocks at an enemy in front of you (a fan over the ground if there is none) and sets it alight
cogwit.trophy.knight_phantom.name: Knight Phantom
cogwit.trophy.knight_phantom.active: Phantom swords: 6 swords appear in the air and fly into the nearest enemies within 14 blocks
cogwit.trophy.ur_ghast.name: Ur-Ghast
cogwit.trophy.ur_ghast.passive: Half the fall damage; sneak in mid-air to drift down gently
cogwit.trophy.ur_ghast.active: Tear bombs: 6 tears fall out of the sky on enemies within 14 blocks, weakening and slowing them
cogwit.trophy.alpha_yeti.name: Alpha Yeti
cogwit.trophy.alpha_yeti.active: Ice block: tears a slab of ice out of the ground and hurls it in an arc at the target; it shatters and freezes everything near
cogwit.trophy.snow_queen.name: Snow Queen
cogwit.trophy.snow_queen.passive: The cold around you slows hostile mobs within 4 blocks
cogwit.trophy.snow_queen.active: Ice prison: a cage of ice holds the 3 nearest enemies for 3 seconds, the cold hurts them, and the cage bursts at the end
cogwit.trophy.yeti.name: Skor, the Yeti

cogwit.guide.hint.cogwit_level_2: I need 200 experience. I grow by blocking damage (1 per HP), saving you from death (+25) and when a boss falls nearby (+200). Level 2 opens the valuables highlight.
cogwit.guide.hint.first_trophy: Kill a boss and I take its trophy: a permanent passive and an active for the wheel (G). Start with the easiest; I'll show you the way.
cogwit.guide.hint.cogwit_level_4: 1000 experience and I can call my brothers ("Brothers" in the wheel): small Cogwits that fight for you. Bosses grow me fastest.
cogwit.guide.hint.cogwit_level_5: 2000 experience opens Overdrive, the full mode. Bosses give 200 each, every blocked HP gives 1.
cogwit.guide.hint.all_trophies: Collect the trophies of every Cataclysm, Mowzie's, Aether, Iron's and vanilla boss. The Trophies tab shows who is left; I lead you to the easiest.

cogwit.guide.tip.1: Tip: hold G for the ability wheel. Trophy actives live there too.
cogwit.guide.tip.2: Tip: in co-op you both get the boss experience and trophy if you were both nearby and hit it.
cogwit.guide.tip.3: Tip: "Think" in the wheel slows enemies and makes you stronger. It costs tokens but pays off in a fight.
cogwit.guide.tip.4: Tip: the Trophies tab of the menu (K) lists every boss, its rewards and where to find it.
cogwit.guide.tip.5: Tip: watch the tokens on the panel. At zero I fall asleep and block nothing.
cogwit.guide.tip.6: Tip: K shows the roadmap with every step and the current hint.
cogwit.guide.tip.7: Tip: token cells in Event Horizon armor feed me on their own, less fuss with copper.

cogwit.guide.hint.twilight_portal: Dig a 2x2 pool of water, ring it with flowers and toss a diamond in. Lightning strikes and the portal to the Twilight Forest opens.

cogwit.help.start.title: Getting Started
cogwit.help.start.1: Craft the talisman: 4 copper blocks in the corners, 3 amethyst shards, a redstone block in the centre, and an Eye of Ender at the bottom middle.
cogwit.help.start.2: Wear it: right-click with the talisman in hand, or put it in the talisman slot.
cogwit.help.start.3: Feed Cogwit: Shift + right-click with copper in hand, or click copper onto Cogwit in the inventory.
cogwit.help.start.4: Raw copper gives 15 tokens, an ingot 30, and a copper block is worth 9 times an ingot.
cogwit.help.start.5: Cogwit learns from each kind of damage: the first hit of a kind is a lesson, and after that he blocks part of it. He does not protect you from other players' damage.
cogwit.help.start.6: Press K to open Cogwit's menu with the path of progression and hints.
cogwit.help.tokens.title: Tokens
cogwit.help.tokens.2: Blocking costs 4 tokens per point of damage; shrugging off a bad effect like poison costs 5.
cogwit.help.tokens.3: Below 200 tokens he says he is hungry.
cogwit.help.tokens.4: At 0 tokens he sleeps for 5 minutes and blocks nothing. A Copper Apple wakes him at once.
cogwit.help.growth.title: Skills and Levels
cogwit.help.growth.1: Each kind of damage is a separate skill. It grows as Cogwit blocks that kind, up to 40% blocked (the server can change this).
cogwit.help.growth.2: Cogwit himself has levels 1-5 at 50, 200, 500, 1000 and 2000 experience.
cogwit.help.growth.3: Levels unlock: an eye, highlighting of valuables, a shield on your back, brothers, and Overdrive.
cogwit.help.growth.4: Brothers are little Cogwits who fight for you. Overdrive is an all-out mode for boss fights.
cogwit.help.growth.5: Experience: 1 per blocked point of damage, 25 for saving you from death, and 200 when a boss dies nearby.
cogwit.help.growth.6: A killing blow is taken by Cogwit: you keep 2 HP with 3 seconds of invulnerability, mobs are thrown back, then he sleeps for 10 minutes.
cogwit.help.armor.title: Event Horizon Armor
cogwit.help.armor.1: Made at a smithing table: a netherite armor piece + Horizon Template + Singularity Core.
cogwit.help.armor.2: Singularity Core: a netherite ingot (or a heavy core, which gives two cores) with 4 echo shards and 4 ender pearls.
cogwit.help.armor.3: Horizon Template: a netherite upgrade template in the centre, echo shards at the sides, crying obsidian in the corners.
cogwit.help.armor.4: Every piece takes off part of the damage you take, more as the mass meter fills: 30% with the whole set, up to 50% at full mass. The boots stop fall damage, the whole set stops fire, and flight (leggings and boots) costs 2 tokens per second.
cogwit.help.armor.5: Mass: a quarter of the damage you take is stored and makes your hits stronger. Full mass unleashes Collapse.
cogwit.help.armor.6: Z dashes: a short burst where you look that keeps your momentum; hits pass through while it lasts. X opens a gravity well. Nearby projectiles turn back, and falling into the void pulls you out.
cogwit.help.armor.7: Downsides: the chestplate draws hostile mobs from afar, every piece is heavy in water, and mass leaks away out of combat. Abilities spare villagers and animals.
cogwit.help.cells.title: Token Cells
cogwit.help.cells.2: Craft: copper ingots in the corners, glass on top and bottom, redstone at the sides, amethyst in the centre.
cogwit.help.cells.3: Charge it by clicking copper, redstone or amethyst onto it.
cogwit.help.cells.4: A lightning strike fills every worn cell, and extra mass in combat charges them too.
cogwit.help.cells.5: Click a cell onto a Horizon armor piece to insert it: helmet 1, chestplate 4, leggings 2, boots 1.
cogwit.help.cells.6: Cogwit draws tokens from worn cells by himself.
cogwit.help.cells.7: To take a cell out, right-click the armor piece in the inventory with an empty hand.
cogwit.help.trophies.title: Boss Trophies
cogwit.help.trophies.1: Kill a boss and everyone who hit it in the last 30 seconds gets its trophy.
cogwit.help.trophies.2: A trophy gives a passive that works while you wear the Horizon chestplate. Most also give an active ability in the wheel.
cogwit.help.trophies.3: The Trophies tab of the menu lists all 35 bosses, their rewards, and where to find them.
cogwit.help.trophies.4: In the Path tab, Cogwit picks the easiest boss you are missing and points a compass to its lair.
cogwit.help.wheel.title: Wheel and Keys
cogwit.help.wheel.1: Hold G, move the mouse onto an action and release to use it. Z dashes, X opens a gravity well.
cogwit.help.wheel.2: The inner ring holds Cogwit's and the armor's actions; the outer ring holds trophy abilities.
cogwit.help.wheel.3: New actions appear in the wheel as they unlock.
cogwit.help.wheel.4: K opens the menu: Path, Trophies, Agent, Help, Settings.
cogwit.help.wheel.5: Y answers "yes" when Cogwit asks something, Shift+Y answers "always".
cogwit.help.wheel.6: Any action can get its own hotkey in Settings → Controls → «Cogwit».
cogwit.help.coop.title: Together
cogwit.help.coop.1: Both players get boss experience and the trophy if both hit the boss.
cogwit.help.coop.2: A friend's stronger skill protects you too when you stand close.
cogwit.help.coop.3: Trophy passives are shared between full armor sets nearby.
cogwit.help.coop.4: Cogwit's hints mention when your friend carries an item you need.
